package protocoldef

//roost:proto package=game.protocol go_package=GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb;pb

type ScenarioCommandRequest struct {
	RoomID   int64  `pb:"1"`
	Seq      uint64 `pb:"2"`
	Revision uint64 `pb:"3"`
	Kind     string `pb:"4"`
	Choice   int32  `pb:"5"`
}
type ScenarioCommandResponse struct {
	Code     int32  `pb:"1"`
	Revision uint64 `pb:"2"`
	Reward   int32  `pb:"3"`
}
type ScenarioProtocol interface {
	//roost:msg id=15001 tags=local
	ScenarioCommand(ScenarioCommandRequest) ScenarioCommandResponse
}
